stories.summary: The controversy over the alleged pulling of the shikha (tuft of hair) of Shankaracharya’s disciples and Brahmin students during the Magh Mela in Prayagraj, along with the UGC Amendment 2026 issue, has triggered strong anger among the Brahmin community and other upper-caste groups. Religious leaders and community members have expressed deep resentment, saying their faith and identity have been hurt. In this backdrop, the by-elections to three Assembly seats in Uttar Pradesh, likely to be held in April-May along with elections in West Bengal, have gained major political importance. The contest is being seen as a semi-final before the big 2027 Assembly battle between the BJP and the SP. Political observers believe that sympathy among upper-caste voters, shifting caste equations and the changing mood of traditional supporters could play a key role. The outcome of these three seats may indicate the future political direction of the state. Will the fire of the UGC controversy, the pulling of students' shikha, and the insult to Shankaracharya trouble the BJP on all three seats? Or will sympathy and caste alliances turn the tide? Read this report Assembly sent information about vacant seats to the election commission The UP Assembly has sent information about the vacancy of all three seats to the Election Commission. It has requested the Election Commission to conduct by-elections soon. Constitutional experts say that if there is more than 6 months left for the general election in any state, then conducting a by-election is mandatory. In such a situation, the possibility of by-elections on all three seats along with West Bengal is being expressed. Out of the three seats, 2 are in Purvanchal and 1 seat is in Ruhelkhand. In Purvanchal, BJP suffered a setback in the 2022 by-election. After this, it also had to face defeat in the Ghosi and Dudhi by-elections. Dara Singh, who won as an SP MLA in Ghosi, joined BJP and became a minister. When he resigned and contested the by-election, he lost to SP. Similarly, in Dudhi, the membership of the BJP MLA was terminated due to a court conviction. Here too, SP defeated BJP in the by-election. Now, both seats will again have by-elections in the same term. Thus, a new record of two by-elections in the same term will also be set on both seats. Ghosi seat became vacant due to the demise of SP MLA Sudhakar Singh of the SP was the MLA from the Ghosi assembly seat in Mau district. He won this seat in the by-election held in 2023 after the resignation of SP MLA Dara Singh Chauhan. Later, Dara Singh Chauhan left SP, joined BJP, and became a minister. In the by-election held after his resignation, SP's Sudhakar Singh won by a huge margin of 42,759 votes. After Sudhakar Singh's demise on November 20, 2025, this seat has become vacant again. Who are the contenders SP has announced the name of Sujit Singh, the younger son of Ghosi MLA Sudhakar Singh, to garner sympathy here. He has been the Block Pramukh of Ghosi twice. Yadav voters are present in large numbers in this constituency. For this reason, former District Panchayat member Vijay Yadav and Mahendra Chauhan, who has been active in the organization for a long time, are also staking their claim. Meanwhile, former BJP MLA Vijay Rajbhar, District Panchayat President Manoj Rai, and social worker Ajay Jaiswal are the main contenders from BJP. OBC voters are decisive on this seat. BJP will try to woo OBC voters through Vijay. Meanwhile, District Panchayat President Manoj Rai is popular in the area due to his political influence, and Ajay Jaiswal is popular due to his work related to social causes. Duddhi: By-election for the second time due to the demise of Vijay Singh Gond MLA Vijay Singh Gond from Duddhi (reserved seat) of Sonbhadra passed away on January 8, 2026. Vijay Singh Gond (71) was a veteran of tribal politics. He became an MLA 8 times. He won from Congress in 1980 and 1985. But in 1989, he contested as an independent and made history by defeating his guru Ram Pyare Panika. Later, he joined Janata Dal and SP. In the 2022 assembly elections, BJP won this seat, but the seat became vacant due to the conviction of MLA Ramdular Gond in a rape case. In the 2024 by-election, Vijay Singh defeated BJP's Shravan Gond. Now, due to his demise, a by-election will be held again in the same term. Who are the contenders? SP has also indicated giving the ticket to Vijay Singh Gond's family on the Duddhi seat, playing the sympathy card. SP can make his younger son Narendra Pratap Singh or mother Krishna Singh the candidate from here. Narendra himself had handled the entire management of his father Vijay Gond while he was alive. He is also politically active. Virendra Pratap Singh, the eldest of Vijay Singh's 3 sons, is a Civil Judge. Middle son Surendra Pratap Singh has left his engineer job in the Water Corporation. If his political ambition awakens, SP might field Vijay Singh's wife Krishna Singh to avoid controversy. Besides them, Ramnarayan Gond, who has been active in the party for a long time, is also staking his claim. Meanwhile, BJP is preparing to bet on Shravan Kumar, who challenged Vijay Singh Gond in the by-election. Apart from him, District Panchayat member Man Singh and Jit Singh Kharwar, active in the organization, are also staking their claim. Faridpur: Dr. Shyam Bihari broke the record on the 'Seat of Change' BJP MLA Dr. Shyam Bihari Lal from Bareilly's Faridpur (reserved) seat passed away on January 2, 2026. This seat is known as the 'Seat of Change'. No MLA could win consecutively twice on this seat. However, Shyam Bihari broke this tradition in 2017 and 2022. Currently, he was Professor and Head of the Department of Ancient History and Culture at Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Rohilkhand University in Bareilly. Additionally, he was also the Director of Panchal Museum and a member of the Board of Governors of Gautam Buddha University, Noida. He started his political journey with ABVP. Due to his demise, a by-election will now be held for this seat. Who are the contenders The very next day after Dr. Shyam Bihari's demise, CM Yogi reached Bareilly to console the family. Dr. Shyam Bihari's wife, Manjulata, is a teacher in the Basic Education Department. His elder daughter, Shilpa Gwal, is an Estate Officer in the Cantonment Board Defense. His younger daughter, Shivani Gwal, works at RBI in Mumbai. 26-year-old son Ishan Gwal is preparing for UPSC in Delhi. The party might bet on his wife or son to garner sympathy. However, ABVP president Jawahar Lal and former district panchayat president Sanjay Singh are also staking their claim from there. While SP might field its former MLA Vijay Pal Singh again. Additionally, Kalpana Sagar and Shalini Singh, who are active in the region from SP, are also making claims.

stories.title: 6 burnt alive in Meerut house:Polyester fabric flared like petrol; no alarm raised, 3 major lapses exposed
stories.summary: In Meerut’s Kidwainagar, six members of a family were burned alive in a fire that broke out in the three-storey house of Iqbal. Among the dead were one woman and five children. On the night of 23 February, the bodies of two girls were buried. On the morning of 24 February, the bodies of a woman and three children were buried. In the graveyard, everyone had the same question — could this tragic incident have been prevented? To find the answer, we reached Islamabad in Kidwainagar. The lane where Iqbal’s house was located was extremely narrow. Even our scooter could not enter. The projections of the houses were so extended that they touched each other. After speaking to locals, it became clear that the rescue operation could have begun earlier. But due to three major lapses, the children could not be saved. First- There were 2 fire extinguisher cylinders on the ground floor. But no one in the house knew how to use them. Second- 13-year-old nephew Shahzada first saw the fire. But he didn't raise an alarm. He went up to the first floor himself. Raised alarm 15 minutes later. Third- There was commercial activity in the house in the narrow lane. There was a large storage of clothes. CFO Surendra Kumar Singh said the polyester fabric spread flames like petrol and the staircase was very narrow. Whoever was on whichever floor remained stuck there. Read the account of witnesses who saw the horrifying scene Read about the atmosphere outside the house on the night of the accident... Men of the locality were offering namaz, and the incident occurred behind them. When we reached outside Iqbal’s house, police had sealed the lower portion with yellow tape. No one could go in or out. The smell of burnt cloth was spreading outside. A large amount of cloth had been thrown out and was lying in heaps in the lane. Debris of burnt fabric lay outside the house. Its smell had spread throughout the lane. Those seen outside had clear sadness on their faces. People were praying just 50 steps away We sat on the stairs of the house. There we met Iqbal’s 15-year-old nephew Shehzada. He said he saw the fire first. We asked him to describe the atmosphere on the evening of 23 February. He said it is the month of Ramzan and everyone in the house was fasting, so after evening all the men had gone about 50 steps away to Surahi-wali mosque for prayers. People from neighbouring houses had also gone. Women were praying inside their homes and some were preparing food for iftar. Nephew said - I was distraught seeing the fire, couldn't even scream The lane was deserted, so no one sensed the fire. I live three houses away. When I stepped outside, I saw flames coming from Uncle Iqbal’s house. He said he ran to the main door. The latch is usually locked from inside but he often opened it from outside. That day too he opened it and went inside. There was smoke everywhere. He started climbing the stairs, but the smoke was so dense he could only go halfway. He did not understand whether to shout or call someone. Instead, he panicked and began running to save everyone himself. Two or three times he tried to go upstairs, but he too began suffocating and could not go further. Meanwhile, the golden rescue time passed. Then he shouted and called neighbours. People started rescue after seeing the fire, but the smoke made him suffocate and he fainted. When he regained consciousness, he found himself in hospital. Elderly Iqbal Said - Father passed away 6 months ago, now family destroyed Iqbal, who lost six family members, sat utterly devastated. He said his father had passed away just a month and a quarter ago. He never imagined such a calamity would strike. His whole family — daughters-in-law, wife, sons — were fasting. They had all gone to the mosque for prayers when the incident occurred behind them. Two fire cylinders were kept in the house, but they remained unused because no one understood how to operate them. “What fault was it of those innocent children that they got this punishment?” he said. Saira who lost 2 children said - I am an unfortunate mother Saira, whose two children died in the fire, said her 12-year-old daughter and 9-year-old son were burned. She was fasting and had still not broken it. Crying, she said her daughter had just returned after giving her Class-5 exam that day. The children were playing at home when the incident happened. “Why did God do this? I couldn’t even see my children’s faces. They were given to me with such difficulty, and now they’re gone. We couldn’t even look at them one last time.” Women around her kept consoling her, telling her to trust God and be patient. But Saira was inconsolable, and they tried to calm her by placing hands on her head and reciting prayers. Both daughters were clinging to Rukhsar's chest Asim’s wife Rukhsar, their 3-year-old son Aqdus, 6-month-old twin daughters Nabiya and Inayat, and son Farooq died. Asim’s father Iqbal’s elderly wife Ameer Bano suffered burns. After the fire was extinguished, firefighters entered. When they reached a second-floor room, their eyes filled with tears. They found the bodies of two daughters clinging to the completely burned body of Rukhsar. It is believed that after the fire started, Rukhsar hugged her infant daughters to her chest. To escape smoke, she locked the room, covered her own mouth with a dupatta and covered another child’s mouth with her hand so smoke would not enter and they might survive. In this way, all gradually suffocated. The fire kept spreading. The family could not even scream and died. Why did the fire break out, 5 major negligences 1. Large cloth storage accelerated fire The ground floor of the three-storey house was used to make cloth from thread. Iqbal and his five sons run a textile business and were operating it in a residential area. Large quantities of cloth, thread and stitching material were stored there. The fire started there and kept spreading. 2. Old city, extremely narrow lane delayed rescue Iqbal’s house is in Lisadi Gate, Kidwainagar, a congested old-city area with very narrow lanes and closely built houses. Projections extend far over the street. Fire engines could not enter on time, delaying firefighting and costing six lives. 3. Narrow stairs prevented escape Saira said the three-storey house was built on just 50–70 square yards. Only the front rooms facing the lane had windows, and even those could not open. Each of the first and second floors had two rooms, with stairs along the side allowing only one person at a time. This is why people could not escape after the fire started. 4. Iron mesh on each floor spread flames upward Shehzada said every floor had large iron mesh structures for ventilation. The fire began on the ground floor. As cloth caught fire, flames rose high and passed through the mesh, quickly reaching the first and then the second floor. 5. Two fire hydrants in house, no one knew how to use them At the time of the incident, no men were present — only women and children. Two fire hydrants were installed on the ground floor where the fire started. But no one knew how to operate them. Even those who came from outside to help could not use them. That is why the fire kept spreading. Fire could have spread throughout the street Locals said cloth work is done in most houses around Iqbal’s home, and every other house stores fabric. Houses are attached from roof to ground. If the fire had spread further, it could have engulfed other homes. Fortunately, it was brought under control in time. Even 1000 liters of water couldn't extinguish the fire The house had a 1,000-litre water tank for domestic use. Before firefighters arrived, neighbours used water from it to try to extinguish the flames. The tank emptied, but the fire could not be controlled. The entire family burned alive. As soon as neighbours learned of the fire, they rushed there. Some tried entering the house but smoke was too dense. When they realised they could not enter through the staircase and the family was trapped upstairs, they used ladders from rooftops and neighbouring houses to enter through windows on upper floors. They pulled out women and children with their hands and threw water from rooftop tanks to douse flames. Ambulance, fire brigade and police were called. Neighbours themselves carried the injured in their arms and ran to the road to place them in ambulances. Now the complete statement from CFO Vehicles reached in 10 minutes, took 2 hours to extinguish CFO Surendra Kumar Singh said two fire engines reached the spot within 10 minutes of the call. Seeing the intensity, two more vehicles were called. But due to narrow lanes, engines could not enter, so two fire bikes were sent. Rescue continued for 15–20 minutes, while extinguishing took about two hours because the blaze had spread widely. He said the fire was caused by a short circuit. Since polyester cloth was stored in the house — a highly combustible material — the fire spread rapidly and engulfed the entire building. The ground floor turned completely black and walls up to the top were charred, making it impossible to determine the exact starting point of the fire. After the incident, the Fire DG directed the department to conduct fire audits in Kidwainagar, Bunakar Nagar and other similar areas of the city where such accidents could occur.

stories.title: CM Yogi celebrates Holi at Gorakhnath Temple:Colourful processions and devotional fervour sweep Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: Holi is being celebrated with great enthusiasm across Uttar Pradesh today. As morning broke, streets and neighbourhoods transformed into a riot of colours, music and celebration. Clouds of abir and gulal filled the air as people exchanged greetings and embraced the festive spirit. Massive devotee turnout in Vrindavan In Vrindavan, thousands of devotees gathered to celebrate Holi in a traditional and spiritual atmosphere. Temples resonated with devotional songs, while pilgrims and locals played with colours in temple courtyards and narrow lanes. The atmosphere remained vibrant yet devotional, reflecting the town’s deep cultural connection with the festival. See pictures Processions and cultural fervour in Gorakhpur Gorakhpur witnessed lively processions, with people dancing to DJ music and celebrating on the streets. The festive mood was visible across the city. MP Ravi Kishan joined the celebrations, applied abir to volunteers and sang traditional ‘Fagua’ songs, adding a cultural flavour to the event. CM Yogi marks Holi at Gorakhnath Temple Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath celebrated Holi at the Gorakhnath Temple in Gorakhpur. He offered prayers and fed jaggery to cows at the temple’s cowshed, continuing his annual tradition. He also applied abir to saints and supporters present at the temple premises. Akhilesh Yadav celebrates in Saifai Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav is celebrating Holi in his native village Saifai. He is expected to mark the occasion with family members, party workers and supporters, as preparations for the gathering were made in advance. Tight security across state Authorities have deployed additional police forces in sensitive areas to ensure peaceful celebrations. Monitoring is underway in major cities to prevent any untoward incidents. From spiritual centres to political strongholds, Holi celebrations across Uttar Pradesh reflect a blend of tradition, culture and community spirit.

stories.title: Farmer leader’s burnt skeleton found in forest after 14 days:Accused arrested following mobile location probe
stories.summary: The burnt skeletal remains of 25-year-old farmer leader Anchal Mishra were recovered from a forest in Shravasti, 14 days after she went missing. She had left home on February 17, telling her family she was attending a farmers’ union meeting. Police traced her last mobile phone location to the Kakardar range forest in the Malhipur police station area. Acting on this lead, a police team reached the site at around 2 pm on March 3 and recovered skeletal remains, including a skull, jaw and spine. Her clothes and shoes were found some distance away. First see 3 pictures... The remains were sealed in polythene and sent for postmortem examination. Police, forensic experts and a dog squad collected evidence from the scene. Anchal Mishra, wife of Santosh Mishra, lived in Bansgadhi Fattepur Bangai village with her two children. She served as the district president of the non-political women’s wing of the Kisan Union. When she did not return home, her family searched extensively before filing a missing person report at Malhipur police station on February 19. During the investigation, police placed her mobile phone under surveillance, which led them to the forest location. Her husband has accused Suraj Verma of murder. He alleged that after the disappearance, Suraj continued to accompany him in the search efforts, pretending to help. Investigators grew suspicious when mobile data showed that both Anchal and the accused were at the same location before she went missing. Police have arrested the accused and further investigation is underway. CO Satish Kumar Sharma said- A missing person report was filed for the woman on February 19. On March 3, the woman's skeleton was recovered from Kakardar jungle. The field unit collected evidence after inspecting the crime scene and took action. The skeleton was sent for post-mortem. A case has been registered and the accused has been arrested. Action is being taken based on evidence.

stories.title: Zeeshan was in touch with Pakistani YouTuber:Posed as Islamic speaker in video, said Babri still burns his heart
stories.summary: The deadly attack on Salim Wastik, who identifies himself as an Ex-Muslim, did not happen suddenly. The faces behind writing the script have not yet come forward. Zeeshan and Gulfam were merely instruments. Details from Zeeshan and Gulfam's bank accounts have made it clear that they were funded. The mobile phone recovered by Ghaziabad Crime Branch from Zeeshan contains several videos on his Instagram account where Zeeshan identifies himself as an Islamic speaker. He says- My heart burns, my eyes well up, when I think about the Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. It was our pride, our identity. What happened to it was injustice. Our wound has not healed to this day. To get to the bottom of this case, the Ghaziabad Crime Branch examined Zeeshan and Gulfam's bank accounts. It was revealed that Zeeshan and Gulfam were regularly receiving funds. The source accounts are from the Loni and Khoda areas of Ghaziabad; this money was being given to Zeeshan to strengthen the organization. The Crime Branch found 15 videos on Zeeshan's mobile phone on his Instagram and Telegram accounts. He had created an account on Instagram named 'Inspire with Zeeshan'. In the VIDEOS, he was constantly making provocative statements. For this, he would use incidents happening in different states as a basis. Zeeshan was also in contact with a Pakistani YouTuber. The police have not publicly disclosed who this YouTuber is. He created this account on September 26, 2025, and uploaded his last video on February 17, 2026. Read the report Zeeshan attacked with a surgical blade, Gulfam with a table leg Youtuber Salim Vastik used to call himself an ex-Muslim. He spoke sharply about triple talaq and halala in Islam. He has more than 30,000 Hearing Salim's screams, people from nearby areas rushed over. When the commotion started, both of them tried to flee on their bikes, but people stopped them. When people protested the attack, Zeeshan and Gulfam started saying - you people should be ashamed. He (Salim) is a Muslim and speaks ill of Islam, and you people just watch silently. Since you people did nothing, we dealt with him. After this, both of them rode away on their bikes. Police later received a video of them fleeing on their bike. Passersby made this video after seeing two blood-soaked people fleeing on a bike. Upon viewing it, it appears that an attempt was made to erase the number on the bike's plate. Their white kurta-pajama was stained with blood. In the video, Zeeshan asks to pick up weapons In the investigation by Ghaziabad Police, it was revealed that Zeeshan and his brother Gulfam were also associated with the radical organization Muslim Army Mehdi Moderator. He used to promote it through a Telegram channel. This group was formed in 2003 after America increased its activities in Iraq. The Shia community worked against the American army in Iraq, and militants were involved in it. Police also found information about this group from Zeeshan's mobile phone. What was Zeeshan's role in this group? Police are investigating this. Zeeshan's brother Gulfam was also involved in all his misdeeds. He is seen in the video appealing to take up arms through religious sermons. He dressed himself like a cleric. ADCP Crime Piyush Kumar Singh says- Zeeshan was instigating young boys by posting videos. He used to talk about taking revenge for the demolition of the disputed structure in Ayodhya in December 1992. Whatever he did is being seen as a conspiracy in this direction. Zeeshan used to do wood interior work Investigation of Zeeshan's mobile revealed that he was greatly influenced by poet Sabir Raza Azhari; most of his poetry was found uploaded on Zeeshan's account. Zeeshan had been living with his elder brother Gulfam in Khoda for the past about 2 years and he used to do wood interior work in Noida. Elder brother Gulfam's encounter The second accused, Gulfam, in the deadly attack on Ghaziabad's EX Muslim YouTuber Salim Vastik, was also killed in an encounter on Tuesday night. The encounter took place in the Indirapuram area. Additional DCP Crime Piyush Singh and the SWAT team killed Gulfam. Gulfam was the elder brother of the main accused, Zeeshan. In the last 48 hours, both real brothers have been killed by the police. More than 20 rounds were fired Additional DCP Crime Piyush Singh said - information was received that Gulfam and his accomplice were in the Indirapuram police station area. Senior officials were immediately informed about this. After this, a cordon was set up in front of Vasundhara Power House to apprehend them. At night, a bike was seen approaching there. Two youths were riding the bike. An attempt was made to stop them. However, instead of stopping the bike, they turned right. After that, they sped up and started fleeing under the elevated road. Upon this, the SWAT team chased both of them. Meanwhile, due to a mound of earth, their bike skidded, causing both criminals to fall. Seeing the police approaching, the criminals started firing. Gulfam and his accomplice fired shots. One of these bullets hit Head Constable Pushpendra Kumar Shukla and Sandeep Kumar.

stories.title: Shankaracharya sidelines real or fake Hindu debate:Focus now shifts to cow issue, Yatra in Lucknow on March 12
stories.summary: The dispute between Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand and UP CM Yogi shows no signs of abating. Shankaracharya is now preparing to shift this dispute to the politics of 'Gomata' (cow mother). He is demanding that Gomata be declared the state mother and that beef exports be banned, from Varanasi to Lucknow. Avimukteshwaranand will roar with this demand in Lucknow on March 12. But the question is whether Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand will get permission for this, like Dhirendra Shastri who was denied permission for a discourse at Rashtra Prerna Sthal in Lucknow? Who will benefit politically from the clash between these two saints? Read this report After the dispute in Magh Mela, they came out against each other Since Shankaracharya was stopped from taking a bath on Mauni Amavasya in the Prayagraj Magh Mela and the subsequent beating of young students (batuks) by pulling their topknots, Shankaracharya and CM Yogi have been attacking each other. At that time, Shankaracharya directly attacked the government. Later, CM Yogi also attacked Shankaracharya without naming him. He had said that there would be many such Kalnemis who would be conspiring to weaken Sanatan Dharma in the guise of religion. We must be careful of them. After this, in the budget session, Yogi had said - Not everyone can write Shankaracharya. Not everyone can go as the Acharya of every Peeth and spoil the atmosphere. Everyone has to follow those decorums. Referring to the tradition of the 4 established Peeths of Adi Shankaracharya, he had said that to become a Shankaracharya, approval by the Vidvat Parishad, Mantra-Bhashya (thesis) and anointment are necessary. No one can declare themselves Shankaracharya. On this, Avimukteshwaranand launched a counter-attack. He had said, they are fake yogis. One thing on the outside, another on the inside... Conduct is more important than attire. Then in a statement, Shankaracharya had said that yogis are worse than Aurangzeb. Avimukteshwaranand is engaged in cornering the government in the name of the cow mother Since the 90s, BJP has always played on the pitch of hardcore Hindutva. In 2017, when BJP got a majority in UP, it made a face like Yogi, who follows hardcore Hindutva, the CM. Shankaracharya is attacking the very identity of BJP's Hindutva. He is now engaged in turning the insult of Magh Mela into the politics of 'Gomata' (cow mother). For this, he is continuously attacking the government. Avimukteshwaranand will embark on a foot march from Varanasi to Lucknow starting March 6. Shankaracharya had given a 40-day ultimatum to the state government to declare 'Gomata' as the 'Rajya Mata' (state mother) and stop beef export. This ultimatum is completing on March 6. On March 11, he will reach Lucknow with supporting saints and common people. On March 12, he will roar against the government with thousands of Hindus in the Ashiana area. This is the complete program: Senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh says- This fight is about Avimukteshwaranand establishing himself. Many saints, including CM Yogi, have refused to accept him as Shankaracharya. There is also a controversy regarding his Shankaracharya status. In such a situation, Avimukteshwaranand is on a two-pronged campaign under the pretext of getting 'Gomata' (cow mother) the status of 'Rajya Mata' (state mother). First- Through this campaign, he wants to establish himself as Shankaracharya. Second- On this issue, he wants to put the UP government in the dock and prove it to be anti-Gomata. Suresh Bahadur Singh further says- The truth is that the CM himself is a devotee of cows. The huge amount allocated for destitute cows in the budget is an example of this. The CM's love for cows is always evident. Permission for the program not yet taken, Deputy CM said - will welcome Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand has not yet taken permission for the program from the Lucknow police-administration. Shankaracharya's close associates claim that the concluding program will be held in the Ashiana area. According to CO Cantt Abhay Pratap Mall, I have not yet received any letter regarding the program. After the application is received, a decision will be taken based on the circumstances. Meanwhile, the side associated with Shankaracharya claims that two sites have been identified in the Ashiana area. Once one of these is finalized, permission will be sought from the administration. Earlier, the Lucknow administration had not granted permission for the discourse of Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, the head of Bageshwar Dham, at Rashtra Prerna Sthal due to concerns about excessive crowd. However, Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya's statement regarding this event is in discussion. He said that if Shankaracharya comes to Lucknow, he will be welcomed as a devotee of Ram. Cows are not even scratched, there is no need to give them the status of state mother. To this, Swami Avimukteshwaranand retaliated. He said that a citizen can go anywhere and in the Sanatan tradition, a guru is welcomed. "But, the claim of cow protection is false. According to government data, the number of cows in UP has decreased by 4%. If they are not scratched, then how did the number decrease?" Who benefits or loses from the saints' dispute? Senior journalist Sharat Pradhan says - The state government is at a loss in the saints' dispute. In Hinduism, there is no position greater than that of Shankaracharya. After this, the way an FIR was filed to corner Shankaracharya, its message also went wrong among the people. A large number of people believe that Shankaracharya was unnecessarily framed. Sharat Pradhan says - The way the crime record of the person who filed the case has come to light, it has hurt the government's dignity. The government may also have to bear its political loss. Especially those people will make this their basis, who keep looking for an opportunity to corner the head of the government. The entire ongoing dispute regarding Shankaracharya

stories.title: CAG report triggers sweeping raids in UP:BSP MLA, associates searched as probe flags ₹172 cr loss and mining transport racket
stories.summary: The syndicate of illegal mining of Dolo stone (gravel) in Sonbhadra district of Uttar Pradesh has now been caught in the clutches of the Income Tax (IT) department. Raids were conducted at the residences of BSP MLA Umashankar Singh and his close associates. In this, the IT department found significant evidence of the nexus between the mining syndicate and officials. This could unmask many big bureaucrats and influential people. In such a situation, it is natural to ask: Where did the Income Tax get the lead from? Where were the raids conducted? What was found in the raids? Whose names are associated with the syndicate that have come to light? We will seek answers to these questions in this news IT got the lead in this whole matter from the CAG report, which was presented in the assembly. The IT department thoroughly studied this report. Then a complete plan for action was prepared. On February 26, 2026, the Income Tax Department raided a total of 30 locations in Lucknow, Ballia, Prayagraj, Mirzapur, and Sonbhadra. During this period, 11 crore rupees, jewelry, expensive watches, vehicles, documents of benami property, several diaries, and important documents related to illegal mining were found from Umashankar's house. In addition, loose sheets of transactions and handwritten notes, suspicious files related to tenders and payments, computer hard disks, and property documents were also recovered. During the investigation, tax evasion of more than 100 crore rupees has been estimated. According to sources, the Income Tax department has obtained some documents. These revealed that CS Infra Construction, a firm registered in the name of Umashankar Singh's wife Pushpa Singh, and Sai Ram Enterprises, a firm of Ramesh Kumar Singh, had formed a syndicate by sidelining old partners. How the whole scheme unfolded To understand this whole scheme, we need to go back a little in time. This was the period when a new syndicate began to spread its influence in the mining department. In the notification issued in 2018, tenders were invited for 4 blocks in Araji No. 7536 of Billi Markundi area in Sonbhadra. At that time, the normal rate in the district was 160 rupees per cubic meter. However, Sai Ram Enterprises placed an astonishing bid of 3010 rupees and CS Infra bid 3000 rupees per cubic meter. The companies secured the leases. In all four blocks, the leaseholders, in mutual coordination, registered only two blocks (1 and 3). Illegal mining was carried out on the rest. The motive was clear: mining would occur across the entire area. But, royalty would be paid to the government for only two blocks. Administration Woke Up After Umbha Incident In 2019, the Umbha incident occurred in Sonbhadra. Several murders took place here over land encroachment. Administrative officers were removed. When the new District Magistrate Rajalingam started supervising mining, his attention fell on those four blocks of Araji No. 7536 in the Billi Markundi area, where only 2 blocks had been allotted. Illegal mining was happening in two blocks. Taking a report from the mining officer, notices were issued to the leaseholders. The special thing was that the fine imposed on the leaseholders for illegal mining was at the minimum rate of 160 rupees per cubic meter. Whereas, these two companies had obtained this lease at the rates of 3010 and 3000 rupees. What did the CAG report reveal? The CAG report presented in the UP Assembly in 2024-25 revealed a big scam going on in the mining department. According to the report, Sai Ram Enterprises caused a loss of 112 crore 10 lakh to the government by illegally mining 62,072 cubic meters. Whereas, CS Infra Construction committed a scam of 60 crore 48 lakh by illegally mining 33,603 cubic meters. The owner of CS Infra Construction is Pushpa Singh, wife of Umashankar Singh. In total, the government suffered a revenue loss of more than 172 crore. The report stated that royalty should have been collected at the auction rate. However, the matter was settled at old and lower rates. The Racket of Illegal Transportation For the transportation of stones illegally extracted from Billi Markundi, cheap-rate leases from Dudhi Tehsil, which cost less than 200 rupees per cubic meter, were used for MM 11. That is, the stone was extracted from Billi Markundi, where the government was supposed to receive 3010 rupees per cubic meter. But, it was sold using a Dudhi lease, whose rate was less than 200 rupees. In reality, no mining took place in Dudhi. The big question is... Whose patronage? The then Mining Director Roshan Jacob had written a letter to the then District Magistrate Sonbhadra Chandra Vijay Singh on July 14, 2023, for action against these companies. He had also asked to cancel these leases. But, instead of action, Roshan Jacob himself was removed from the department. This lease, in the name of Sai Ram Enterprises, is still ongoing. Sources say that this was possible only due to the patronage of an officer holding an important position in the government. Did small investors lose their money? On February 26, the Income Tax Department raided the premises of most partners of Sai Ram Enterprises. During this, most partners stated that they were indeed partners, but they neither received their money back nor any profit. Most partners informed the Income Tax officials about this syndicate of the mining department. It included BSP MLA Umashankar Singh, Ramesh Kumar Singh, and Ramashankar Dubey. Income Tax is now verifying this from Sai Ram Enterprises' balance sheet and bank accounts. The Income Tax Department has found some evidence that could disturb the sleep of some bureaucrats. Turnover increased 5 times in 4 years The company CS Infra Construction Limited, running in the name of Umashankar Singh's wife, has been getting contracts not only from the mining department but also from the Mandi Parishad and PWD departments. Umashankar Singh's assets grew rapidly after 2021-22. In 2021-22, the total turnover of CS Infra Construction Limited was Rs 271.39 crore. In 2022-23, it became Rs 402.26 crore, in 2023-24 it was Rs 777.14 crore, and in 2024-25 it reached Rs 1005.42 crore.

stories.title: Second accused who stabbed Saleem Wastik killed in encounter:Younger brother of YouTuber attack culprit was killed 48 hrs ago
stories.summary: The second accused in the deadly attack on Ghaziabad's ex-Muslim YouTuber Saleem Wastik, Gulfam, was also killed in an encounter. The encounter took place in the Indirapuram area. Additional DCP Crime Piyush Singh and the SWAT team took down Gulfam. Gulfam was the elder brother of the main accused, Zeeshan. In the last 48 hours, police have killed both brothers. Actually, on the night of February 27 in Ghaziabad, both brothers together stabbed YouTuber Saleem Wastik 14 times. Saleem's condition is still serious. He is fighting between life and death at Delhi's GTB Hospital. More than 20 rounds of firing took place Additional DCP Crime Piyush Singh said - On Tuesday night, 2 suspects were fleeing on a bike towards Vasundhara in Indirapuram. When the SWAT team and police signalled them to stop, one criminal opened fire at the police with a pistol. A constable was shot in this incident. After this, both criminals abandoned the bike and started running on foot. That's when the police surrounded them. Subsequently, more than 20 rounds were fired between the police and criminals. One criminal was killed after being hit by bullets. The deceased criminal was identified as Gulfam, son of Buniyad Ali. He was a resident of Syed Nagli in Amroha. Additional DCP said - After the encounter, Gulfam was taken to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Meanwhile, the second attacker escaped from the scene, taking advantage of the darkness. An Aadhar card, a knife, a revolver and a pistol have been recovered from them. Some cartridges were also found. The bike found at the scene is being investigated. Both criminals fired more than 12 shots at the police. Earlier, on the night of March 1, Gulfam's brother Zeeshan was killed by police in an encounter. The Loni station in-charge had a narrow escape in this. A bullet hit his bulletproof jacket. While 2 other policemen were also shot. They are being treated at the district hospital. Zeeshan also had a reward of one lakh rupees declared on him. Now know what the matter is? YouTuber who left Islam was stabbed 14 times YouTuber Salim Wastik, who had left Islam, was viciously attacked in his office in broad daylight. According to police, on March 27, masked attackers who came on a bike without number plates launched a series of knife attacks on Salim. They attempted to slit his throat. Upon hearing his screams, the attackers fled, leaving him half-dead. Neighbours heard the commotion and informed the family. Family members took Salim to the hospital. From there, he was referred to Delhi's Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTB). He has 14 wounds on his body, including chest, stomach, neck, arms and legs. Police filed an FIR against 7 people, including an AIMIM leader, based on the son's complaint. On the incident, CM Yogi said-Those who mess with law and order will not be spared. There is no place for terror in UP. MP Manoj Tiwari also visited the hospital. Meanwhile, police placed Mahamandaleshwar Yati Narsinghanand Giri under house arrest when they received information about his plans to visit the hospital. Salim runs a channel on YouTube under the name 'Salim Vastik 0007'. He raises questions about Islam and madrasa education. 3 weeks ago, he posted a video. He said - My Facebook-Instagram was deleted. I had 3.5 lakh followers. You people cannot silence me with such hooliganism. This will not make your religion right. You people cannot do anything to me. As long as the BJP government is there. Hindus are in power. Attackers entered the office and stabbed with knives According to local residents, YouTuber Salim Ahmad, aka Salim Wastik (50) lives with his family in Ashok Vihar Colony of the Loni area. He owns two houses at a distance in the area. He has set up his office in one house. He lives with his wife and son in the other house. According to police, Salim was in the office on Friday. His son Usman said that at 9 AM, when his father was alone in the office, two unknown youths wearing helmets came and attacked. As soon as they entered, they were repeatedly stabbed with knives. He fell to the ground, injured and started bleeding. Meanwhile, the attackers fled. Neighbours who arrived after hearing screams saw that Salim was groaning in pain. They picked him up and sent him to the hospital. Usman has filed a complaint with the police. In it, he has named Ashfaq, Sonu, Shahrukh Neta, Bhati Builder and a local AIMIM leader, Azgar. He has alleged that these people had conspired to murder Salim. Hindu organizations held protest outside hospital Upon receiving information about the attack, Hindu Raksha Dal president Pinky Chaudhary sat on a protest with his supporters on the road outside GTB Hospital. Meanwhile, BJP MP and Bhojpuri actor Manoj Tiwari reached the spot. He gathered information about the incident from Pinky Chaudhary.

The impact caused a severe jolt, leaving the vehicle badly damaged. 3 people standing in the rear of the pickup were thrown nearly 6 feet into the air and landed about 15 feet ahead. The driver suffered a fatal head injury after hitting the steering wheel and died inside the vehicle. A 3-year-old girl seated behind him also lost her life. 4 others were injured in the crash. After receiving information, the UPIDA team reached the spot and began rescue operations. The injured were taken by ambulance to the Community Health Centre in Bangarmau for initial treatment and later referred to the district hospital. The accident took place on Tuesday morning near kilometre 224 under the Bangarmau Kotwali area on the Agra–Lucknow Expressway. Monu lives in Arsem village in the Auras police station area. Monu was returning to Unnao from Faridabad in a pickup with his family, Shivmurti (32), Munshilal (40), Mahak (8), and Shiksha (3) during Holi. The pickup was being driven by Ashok Kumar (30), a resident of village Satku Khera in Achalganj. On the Agra-Lucknow Expressway, the driver suddenly lost control of the steering and the pickup crashed into the divider. The video clearly shows the speeding pickup approaching the divider. Then suddenly, the front wheels climb onto the divider. After this, the pickup crashed into the divider wall. The collision was so severe that the young men sitting in the back of the pickup were thrown into the air and fell between the dividers. One young man fell about 15 feet ahead, while 2 young men fell 10 feet ahead and started writhing. One young man fell near the rear tire when the pickup's body burst. After some time, he gathered courage and started shouting for help. Blood started flowing outside the pickup Upon receiving information, the UPDA team arrived with a crane and ambulance. The injured were rescued. During this, driver Ashok Kumar got crushed between the pickup's engine and steering. His blood started flowing outside the pickup. He was extracted by cutting the pickup with a cutter. After this, everyone was taken to CHC by ambulance, where doctors declared the driver and 3-year-old Khushi dead. Meanwhile, 4 injured were referred to the district hospital. After this, the police removed the pickup and started the traffic. Father said - Son was returning from Faridabad Driver Ashok Kumar's father, Suresh, said - His son used to drive a loader vehicle from Faridabad. He was coming home for Holi. Other people were also returning with him. The accident happened in the morning. The police had called to inform us about our son's injury. When I came here, found my son's body. Ashok was the elder of 2 brothers. He supported the family by working as a driver. The family includes his wife, a three-year-old son, and a 4-year-old daughter. Meanwhile, Shiksha (2), daughter of Monu, was the youngest of two sisters. Shiksha's parents and her elder sister were also in the pickup, who were seriously injured.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav's daughter AI-generated image posted online:Captioned ‘love you more than my life’; SP MLC lodges FIR
stories.summary: An Instagram user has posted an AI-generated image of the daughter of Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav, accompanied by the caption: ‘I love you more than my life.’ The user has shared around 318 posts in total, more than 100 of which reportedly feature images of Akhilesh Yadav’s daughter. After the post went viral, SP MLC Dr. Mansingh Yadav lodged an FIR at the Cyber Police Station in Prayagraj. He demanded that the individual behind the account be identified, strict action be taken, and the profile be immediately deactivated. See 2 pictures- Complaint alleges attempt to tarnish family’s image In his written complaint, Dr. Mansingh Yadav stated that an AI-generated photograph of the SP chief’s daughter had been created and uploaded on Instagram from an account named ‘Shekhar’. He alleged that the user was posting baseless and obscene content. The complaint further said that such posts were tarnishing the image of a nationally respected family and described the act as part of a ‘well-planned conspiracy’. Given that millions of people use Instagram, he noted, the circulation of such content has caused anger among party workers and supporters. In the submission to the cyber police, he specifically mentioned that posts from the user ID ‘Shekhar93653’ were spreading rapidly and should be stopped without delay. Party condemns incident SP spokesperson Dan Bahadur Madhur said the party strongly condemns the incident and will make every possible effort to ensure that the person responsible is punished. Police have yet to issue a detailed statement on the progress of the investigation.

stories.title: Woman commits suicide 11 days before wedding in Jalaun:Writes note, ‘Get my younger sister married to my fiancé’; father died 6 days ago
stories.summary: I am committing suicide because of sister Roli Prajapati. She mentally tortured me. She didn't get father treated for her wedding. If she had focused on treating father who was battling cancer instead of rushing for marriage, he would be among us today. My last wish is that after my death, my younger sister should be married to my fiance. These words were written by Neha Prajapati from Jalaun in her suicide note. Then on Tuesday, she committed suicide by hanging herself in the kitchen of the house. A suicide letter was found at the spot. In this, Neha accused her elder sister Roli of torture. Police sources said - Neha was third among four sisters. Two elder sisters, Meenu (29) and Roli (26), were already married. Younger sister Raksha (18) is studying. Roli got married on February 12. Neha's wedding date was fixed for March 14. Meanwhile, the father passed away. Then Neha felt that Roli had rushed into her marriage. She did not pay attention to her father's treatment. If she had focused on her father's treatment instead of her marriage, he would be alive today. Both were having a fierce fight over this. The matter is from Gokhale Nagar of Konch Kotwali. Now read what is written in the letter- Neha wrote that her sister Roli Prajapati was responsible for her decision, alleging that she had been mentally harassing her. She stated that she was ending her life because she could no longer bear it. She mentioned that money from her and her father’s bank accounts could be withdrawn after obtaining their death certificates, and advised the family to seek help from Rahul, who runs a Jan Seva Kendra in Chandrakuan, for the formalities. Neha wrote that she had ₹34,000 in her bank account and ₹14,000 kept in a black register under her book, making a total of ₹48,000. She asked that the amount given by her fiancé, Master alias Ankit, for her father’s medicines and chemotherapy be returned first. From the remaining sum, she requested that ₹20,000 be repaid to those from whom her elder sister had borrowed money for their father’s treatment. She further asked Ankit to return ₹2.5 lakh and said the amount should be kept in Raksha’s name for her future. She provided details about the location of keys, the trunk key kept in the same register as the cash, another key inside a school bag in the trunk, and the safe key in Raksha’s college bag. In her final message, Neha asked Ankit to forgive her and requested that Ankit and Muskan (Raksha) be married as planned, since bookings and advance payments had already been made. She wrote that while it was easy for her to say this, it would not be easy to carry out, and she sought forgiveness from everyone. Police said - investigating the case CO Konch Parmeshwar Prasad said- The case is being investigated. The matters written in the suicide note are also being looked into. For now, the body has been sent for post-mortem and all investigations are being carried out with the help of the forensic team.

stories.title: UP's coal trader's son and daughter-in-law stuck in Dubai:Had gone for pre-wedding photoshoot, was supposed to return on March 2
stories.summary: A coal-hotel businessman's son from Chandauli, UP, and his daughter-in-law, along with 5 family members, are stranded in Dubai. They all went to Dubai for a pre-wedding photoshoot. Everyone is stuck there due to flight cancellations amid the bombing in the Middle East. They are all staying at a hotel near Burj Khalifa. The family has appealed to PM Modi for a safe return. Their wedding is in April, and preparations are ongoing at home. Cards have been printed, and invitations are being sent to relatives. Father said - Son was supposed to return yesterday Coal trader Ajay Jain lives in Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Nagar. He says - My elder son, Prince Jain (27), is getting married in April. He has gone to Dubai with his fiancée, Payal Jain (26), for a pre-wedding shoot. Along with Prince, Payal's younger son Arihant (19), Payal's brother Monu Jain (30), and his wife Muskan (28) are also there. All of them left from Varanasi for Delhi on February 25 and reached Dubai on February 27. After the photoshoot, everyone was supposed to return on March 2. Ajay Jain said - They are staying in a hotel near Burj Khalifa. However, flight services have been suspended due to the Iran-related conflict and increasing tension in the region. Because of this, they could not return to India as planned. The stranded family members have also contacted the Indian Embassy in Dubai. They have been advised to contact the concerned airline. But they have not received clarity on their return. Businessman Appeals to PM Modi for Safe Return Ajay says - I want to request the Modi government to safely evacuate all Indians and my children who are stranded there. Everyone is staying at the Jubair Hotel next to Burj Khalifa. So far, 600 missiles have been fired there. Regarding government support, Ajay says that he received a call from the DM's office. They have noted down the address. Getting updates through video calls, concern remains Ajay Jain said - Family members in India are in constant contact with their son and daughter-in-law through video calls. Amidst wedding preparations at home, everyone's only concern is that the children return home safely. Our son had gone for the pre-wedding shoot. He was supposed to return, but now he is stuck there. We appeal to the government that, along with our children, all Indians who are stranded there should be brought back safely. Dubai is a favorite destination for youth Dubai is a favorite destination for Indian youth. It offers tall buildings, seaside views, and modern locations. That's why Prince's pre-wedding shoot was planned months in advance, with photographers and locations finalized. However, sudden regional tensions and bombing from Iran disrupted all plans. Although Dubai is not directly in the war zone, international tensions have affected flights. Airlines have changed some routes, and passengers are having to wait for alternative arrangements. For this reason, the family is currently forced to stay in the hotel.

stories.title: 6 people died in UP road accident:Double-decker bus collides with eco van; couple was on way to celebrate Holi
stories.summary: A double-decker bus collided with an Eco van in Hathras, Uttar Pradesh. 6 people died in the accident. Among the deceased, three people, including a couple, were residents of Rajakhera in Dholpur, while three were from Agra. The accident occurred early Tuesday in the Sadabad Kotwali area on the Yamuna Expressway. The bus, which was going from Delhi to Gorakhpur, hit the Eco van. The collision was so severe that the Eco fell about 10 feet away, and its rear part was completely damaged. The deceased include Dinesh (50), son of Hotam Singh, and his wife Sunita (45), residents of Gangoliapura in Rajakhera, Dholpur. The husband and wife were returning to their ancestral village from Noida to celebrate Holi. The third deceased was Lokesh (25), son of Bhuri Singh, who was a resident of Somli ka Gher. After the accident, there was chaos at the spot and bodies were scattered on the road. A long traffic jam occurred on the expressway. Upon receiving information, police officers reached the spot and started relief work. The injured were immediately taken to Khandauli (UP) CHC, from where three seriously injured were referred to Agra. Hathras SP Chiranjiv Nath Sinha said - there were a total of 13 people in the Eco. 6 people died in the accident, while 7 people, including Eco driver Virendra, are injured. The injured were admitted to hospitals in the Khandauli police station area for treatment, from where three were referred to Agra. Initial investigation revealed that the accident occurred due to high speed and careless overtaking. The bus driver is being questioned. Worked as a confectioner in Noida Dinesh lived in Noida, UP, with his wife Sunita and two sons, Rahul (20) and Sumit (19). He had been working there as a confectioner for about 30 years. Dinesh's younger brother Shiv Singh also works at a sweet shop in Noida. Shiv Singh said - On Sunday, I talked to my brother (Dinesh) about coming to the village, but he refused. After that, I left for the village by bus and reached the village on Monday night. Shiv Singh said that when he woke up, there was a call from his elder brother's phone to the home informing about an accident on the Yamuna Expressway. As soon as information about the incident was received, mother Govindi, Shiv Singh's wife Mamta, and two nephews, Bholu and Chakodi, left for UP with their uncle's son Mukesh. Meanwhile, both of Dinesh's sons, Rahul and Sumit, also left for the accident site. Dinesh's father, Hotam Singh, does farming in the village. He has four sons and two daughters. All are married. The eldest is Dinesh, Bachchu Singh, who died three months ago, Shiv Singh, Sanju Singh, and sisters Sawanti and Saroj. Lokesh had a baby girl, 3 months ago Lokesh (25), who lost his life in the accident, was a resident of the Somali ka Gher village in Rajakheda. He was the son of Bhuri Singh. Lokesh had been working in Delhi making pastry cakes for about 10 years. Lokesh was also in the Eco and was going to his village to celebrate the Holi festival. Lokesh's father, Bhuri Singh, does farming work in the village. Lokesh was married 6 years ago and has four daughters. The youngest daughter is 3 months old.

stories.title: Student murdered for lodging rape complaint in Basti:Accused entered house at midnight, shot her in chest and neck while she slept
stories.summary: A minor 12th-grade student who filed a rape FIR in Basti was murdered by a deranged person who shot her. At midnight on Monday, he entered the house through the back entrance and fired at the sleeping student. One bullet hit her head, and another hit her neck. The student died on the spot. According to the family, her brother woke up hearing the gunshots. When he rushed there, the accused threatened him with a pistol. He assaulted him. During his escape attempt, the mother came in the way. He fired at her, too, but missed the target. The mother chased him, but the accused escaped. Police arrived on the scene and investigated the crime. They questioned the mother and brother. They said that the accused Mandeep is from the same village. He was stalking their daughter. The accused had sexually assaulted their daughter a few months ago. He had recorded obscene photos and videos. When the daughter distanced herself, he started threatening to make them viral. He also leaked some photos. Upon learning this, an FIR was filed against him under the POCSO Act at Kalwari police station. He had been absconding since then. He returned to the village on Monday and killed his daughter. According to police, the minor girl from a village in the Kalwari police station area lived with her mother and brother while her father worked in Punjab. Her brother was pursuing graduation, while the girl was taking her 12th board exams. The mother said, 'On Monday night, we had dinner and went to sleep. My son and daughter were sleeping inside the house. I was sleeping outside. Around 1 AM, I heard the sound of a gunshot. As soon as I got up and ran towards my daughter's room, the attacker also fired at me, but the bullet missed. I chased him, but he managed to escape.' When I went inside, I saw that my daughter had been shot in the head and neck. She was lying on her bed, covered in blood. My son was also lying injured nearby. When I asked my son, he told me that Mandeep had shot his sister. When I tried to save her, he attacked my head with a pistol. They informed the police.' 'Had been harassing the girl for two years.' The mother said that the accused Mandeep had been harassing my daughter for two years. A few months ago, he mixed intoxicants in food and fed it to my daughter and forcibly assaulted her. He took pictures and made videos. After this, he started pressuring her to marry him. Once, he was forcibly taking her to the temple to marry her. He was saying - if you don't marry me, I'll consume poison. I'll kill you too. That's when we somehow managed to rescue our daughter from his clutches. 'When daughter maintained distance, he leaked obscene photos' Mother said - When her daughter started keeping distance from him, he began threatening to leak her photos and videos. On December 18, 2025, Mandeep leaked some obscene photos on social media. In this matter, I filed a complaint at the Kalwari police station. Police registered a case under the IT Act, to which rape charges were also added later. After the case was registered, the accused fled from his home. ASP Shyamakant said- The body has been taken into custody and kept in the mortuary. Action is being taken after taking a statement from the family members. A police team has been formed to arrest the accused.

stories.title: Zishan, killed in police encounter, had wedding planned:Father says he was meeting girl; brothers slit YouTuber Salim Wastik’s throat
stories.summary: CCTV footage has emerged showing Zeeshan Saifi and his brother Gulfam near the house of Ghaziabad YouTuber Salim Wastik in Loni. The video shows both men fleeing on a bike, their clothes stained with blood. Police sources said that after the attack, the brothers went to their rented room in Khoda, changed their clothes, and then escaped. Investigators believe they had planned the attack 15 days earlier after scouting the area. A brief check into Zeeshan Saifi’s background revealed that he, a resident of Amroha, studied in a madrasa for three years. After passing his 12th-grade exams in 2021, he moved to Noida to live with Gulfam and started doing small jobs. Zeeshan’s father said they were planning his marriage soon, but he was killed before it could happen. Zeeshan last visited his family home in Saidnangli on February 16 and left the next day. Salim Wastik has undergone two surgeries at a Delhi hospital, and his condition remains serious. The brothers reportedly stabbed him 14 times in broad daylight and attempted to slit his throat. After leaving him bleeding and half-dead, they escaped. Where did they go after this? What did they do? Who were they in touch with? To understand this, the Dainik Bhaskar team reached Saidnangli village in Amroha. Read the report Changed clothes at the rented house, seen in CCTV Zeeshan lived on rent in Khoda, Ghaziabad. Police investigation revealed that after attacking Salim on Friday morning, Zeeshan first reached his rented room in Khoda with his brother. Both had blood-stained clothes, after which they changed clothes in the room. The police also saw this in different CCTVs. Police say that after attacking Salim, both entered Delhi, then from the Delhi border, they reached the room in Khoda on the Ghaziabad border. They stayed in the room for about an hour, and also changed clothes here. Father reached Ghaziabad to collect son's body, brreaks down in tears Zeeshan's father says- On the night of March 1, the police from Nagli police station came and had my door opened. At that time, I was about to go to sleep. The police said that your son Zeeshan was killed in an encounter in Loni, Ghaziabad district. I was shocked to hear that. I said- Inspector sir... has my son committed any crime? My family has never even had a case filed under Section 151. My two sons, Gulfam and Zeeshan's, mobile phones were switched off since Friday. I thought, I don't know what happened, why are the phones off. That same night, I came to know that Zeeshan didn't survive. Father Buniyad Ali says- On Saturday morning, Zeeshan had come home, but he left saying he had some work. While the elder son, Gulfam, left home for Delhi in the evening. Then we didn't talk. The father said that if he had known that his son had committed a crime, he would have tried to make him understand. 'I don't know how all this happened. I have never even seen police at my house', he added. House in 45 square yards, shop outside In Amroha district, 30Km ahead of Gajraula on Sambhal Road is Saidnangli town. Here, 60-year-old Buniyad Ali has an ancestral house in 45 square yards. There is a small door on the outside. Next to it is a shop, whose shutter was closed. Buniyad Ali has been working with wood for the past 40 years. He has 5 daughters, all of whom are married. He had two sons, Gulfam and Zeeshan. After Zeeshan's encounter, there is an atmosphere of fear throughout the village. The elder brother, Gulfam, is absconding. People fear that the police might raid at any time in search of Gulfam. In such a situation, people seemed to avoid talking. Zeeshan's relatives had come a month ago A 40-year-old woman, 100 meters from Zeeshan's house, said, "We are very scared. Just don't take our photos or videos. Don't know what the government might do. Gulfam is married; he used to live in Delhi with his wife, and now it's known that he is living in Khoda, Ghaziabad." The woman further stated that Zeeshan's marriage was being discussed. For this, two people had come from Sambhal. They had asked what Zeeshan does? They were told that he works in furniture with his brother Gulfam. Perhaps Zeeshan was to get married soon. Never heard of any family dispute Ateeq Ahmed, who lives next door to Zeeshan's house, says - Buniyad is a very gentle person. We have never heard this family fighting with anyone. Here, Buniyad Ali lives with his wife. He must be earning 400-500 rupees daily. Zeeshan used to come home sometimes. He was never seen roaming in the neighborhood. He used to be lost in his own world. But no one had any idea that he would do something like this. When we came to know about the encounter, we were shocked. Noor Mohammad says - Family is kind-hearted, don't know what happened to the son Noor Mohammad, 35, who lives in the neighborhood, said - Never heard of any quarrel with Zeeshan or his brother. Their father has an old wood business. Both brothers rarely came home. The elder one, Gulfam, is married, we heard from neighbors that an incident happened with Zeeshan in Ghaziabad, but we cannot say anything about it. Because the family was very kind-hearted, don't know what happened to the son. Now know the full story of the encounter DCP Piyush Singh said- On Sunday night, Loni Police Station in-charge Nitin Chaudhary and the rural SWAT team saw 2 suspects coming on a bike. They tried to stop them, but both fired at the police with pistols. Firing continued from both sides for about 15 minutes, with 25 to 30 rounds fired. SO Loni's bulletproof jacket was hit by a bullet. A bullet also hit the criminal. He was injured. He told the police - I, along with my accomplice, had attacked Salim. After the incident near Nihora underpass, the police took the injured person to the 50-bed hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Police recovered a .32 bore 'Made in Italy' pistol, 6 cartridges, 8 spent casings, and a Splendor bike from the spot. Police are scanning Zeeshan's social media account. Several of his videos have been found on Instagram. A message from a person has also been found in the video. In it, he is saying that one day there will be no sunlight. Stars will fall. Read the Quran and see.

stories.title: Teacher filmed offering UP Board exam swap for ₹10,000:Claims student can be home during the paper without worry
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Board examinations for Classes 10 and 12 began on February 18 amid strong claims of strict monitoring and a complete crackdown on cheating. Officials have repeatedly stated that this year’s exams are being conducted in a transparent manner, with CCTV cameras, voice recorders and outside observers deployed to prevent malpractice. However, an on-ground investigation has revealed a different reality. Reporters found teachers and school staff allegedly offering to arrange cheating, student impersonation and even guaranteed passes for money. Official claims of strict monitoring and transparency In the Agra district, around 350 kilometres from Lucknow, information was received about a government school in Shamshabad town, Fatehabad area, near the Chambal region. It was alleged that students were being replaced by others to write exams on their behalf. After reaching the area and observing the situation for three days, reporters approached a teacher identified as Yogesh Kumar. On the first day, he denied that any cheating was taking place at the school. Investigation begins In Agra government school The investigation then moved to Shri Nathilal Inter College in the same area. Its examination centre was located at the same government school where the allegations of student swapping had surfaced. Through a local source, reporters managed to establish contact and obtained a student’s admit card to make the discussion appear genuine. Admit card used to strike deal When they later met Yogesh Kumar again, this time with the source and the admit card, he allegedly agreed to strike a deal. Posing as relatives of a student whose two papers had gone badly, the reporters asked what help could be provided for the remaining exams. Yogesh reportedly demanded Rs 10,000 to arrange for another student to sit in place of the original candidate for the remaining three papers. An advance of Rs 1,500 was paid in cash. The teacher demands money for a student swap During the conversation, Yogesh allegedly explained how the system could be manipulated despite identity checks. Since the admit card carries the student’s photograph and Aadhaar card verification is conducted at the centre, the reporters asked how impersonation would be possible. Yogesh claimed he would arrange for another Aadhaar card to be made in the same name as the original student. According to him, the impersonating student would bring his own Aadhaar card, while the original admit card would be handed over to him. He said he would get a new Aadhaar card prepared and ensure entry into the examination hall. Plan explained to bypass identity checks He also assured that he would brief the impersonator about the room number and other details. He suggested that since only two papers had been completed so far, and three were still left, the new student could attend without raising suspicion about absence in earlier papers. He asked for the roll number and promised to inform the concerned staff. Advance paid and assurances given From Agra, the investigation moved to Gorakhpur district. In Rampur Pandey village under the Khajni area, Narayan Inter College, a government-run institution, has reportedly been known for cheating activities in the past. An employee named Dilip Pandey was identified as a key figure who allegedly influences the functioning of the college. Similar allegations surface in Gorakhpur district Reporters first contacted him by phone and later visited his residence in Rampur Pandey. Some teachers from the same college were present during the meeting. Unlike the Agra teacher, Dilip Pandey did not openly promise impersonation, citing strict surveillance measures such as CCTV cameras and voice recording systems. He said that times had changed and that earlier answer sheets used to be written at his house, but now such open practices were difficult. Employee Promises Help Despite Surveillance However, he assured that “full help” would be provided to the student during the examination. He stated that although no one would risk their job openly due to heavy monitoring, teachers could still guide or assist students discreetly. For instance, when the invigilator checks copies for signatures or when a student goes to the washroom, hints could be given. He said that the invigilator on duty would be informed about the student so that as much help as possible could be extended. Offer of a guaranteed pass next year He also admitted that he had not been assigned examination duty this time because his role had previously attracted attention. If he had been on duty, he implied, arrangements would have been easier. He mentioned that external teachers were also deployed at centres, which made open cheating more difficult. Despite this, he maintained that assistance could still be arranged to some extent. Importantly, Dilip Pandey went further by offering a future guarantee. He claimed that if the student failed this year despite the help provided, he could ensure a guaranteed pass next year without the student even appearing for the exam. According to him, the form could be filled at another centre where answer sheets would be written at his house. He admitted that this would cost more money but promised a full guarantee of passing. Officials maintain exams are fully secure Despite these revelations, officials have maintained that the examination process is secure. Amarkant Singh, District Inspector of Schools (DIOS) of Gorakhpur, stated that UP Board examinations are being conducted with complete strictness and transparency. He asserted that cheating is not possible at any centre and that monitoring systems are fully active. Attempts made to seek official response Attempts were made to seek responses from higher authorities. When contacted, the Personal Assistant to Gulab Devi, Minister of the Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Department, asked for written questions, which were sent. A response is awaited. Similarly, repeated calls were made over three days to Agra’s District Inspector of Schools, Chandrashekhar, but he did not answer. Questions were later sent to him via WhatsApp, which were seen, and a response is awaited. The investigation highlights a sharp contrast between official claims and alleged ground realities. While authorities insist that CCTV cameras, voice recorders and external observers have made cheating impossible, the recorded conversations suggest that some teachers and school employees are still willing to manipulate the system for money. Offers ranged from arranging impersonators with fake Aadhaar cards to providing in-exam assistance and even guaranteeing future passes without appearing for exams. As the board examinations continue, the revelations raise serious questions about enforcement, accountability and the effectiveness of monitoring mechanisms. Official responses are awaited to clarify the action that will be taken in light of these findings.

stories.title: 13-year old boy shot dead at friend’s birthday party:Police detain 3 minors in Lucknow; probe accidental firing claim
stories.summary: A 13-year-old Class 7 student was killed after being shot during a birthday party in Lucknow’s Sarojini Nagar area. The incident occurred while he was celebrating a friend’s birthday, where a bullet was allegedly fired accidentally and struck him in the forehead. The deceased, Unaiz, was the son of Jameer Khan, a resident of Behsa Shaheed Path and an electronics shop owner. Unaiz studied at Stella Mary School. According to the family, his classmate Navneet came to their house around 3:30 pm on Friday along with his driver. Two other friends, Kartikey and Abhinav, were also in the car. The four boys then went to Navneet’s residence for the birthday celebration. See pictures Around 7:30 pm, Unaiz’s family received a WhatsApp call from Navneet’s father, Sanjeev Tripathi, informing them that the boy had been admitted to Lokbandhu Hospital following an incident. The family was initially told it was a road accident. However, when they reached the hospital, they were later informed that Unaiz had died during treatment. Police took custody of the body and sent it for post-mortem. Father alleges conspiracy Unaiz’s father, Jameer Khan, alleged that his son was shot in the head and that there was an attempt to cover up the incident. He claimed they were not allowed to see the child immediately at the hospital. When police later showed them the body, they found a bullet wound in the middle of his forehead. The father further alleged that there had been tension earlier and claimed that Sanjeev Tripathi had issued threats during a previous parent-teacher meeting. He has accused those present of conspiring in his son’s death. Pistol taken from car, fired during play According to a resident of the apartment complex, the children were celebrating inside the flat before some of them went down to the parking area. They reportedly sat inside a parked car for some time, where a licensed pistol was kept. The children allegedly took the firearm back to the flat. During handling, the gun is believed to have gone off accidentally, hitting Unaiz in the forehead. Police detain 3 minors DCP Nipun Agarwal said that police received information late Monday evening that a 13-year-old boy had died due to accidental firing during a birthday party attended by three of his friends. All three minors present at the party have been taken into custody and are being questioned. Police have registered a case based on the complaint filed by the deceased’s father. Further investigation is underway.

stories.title: Holi rush triggers fare surge in MP:Bhopal–Lucknow bus tickets soar to Rs 8,899 despite CM’s warning
stories.summary: With heavy passenger movement during the Holi festival in Madhya Pradesh, private bus operators are allegedly charging inflated fares. Travellers trying to return home are facing steep ticket prices, especially on long-distance routes. On online booking platforms, fares from Bhopal to Lucknow have climbed as high as Rs 8,899 — several times higher than normal days. Fares up to 4 times higher Under usual circumstances, tickets from Bhopal to Satna cost between Rs 1,000 and Rs 1,200. However, on the Red Bus app, fares are currently showing up to Rs 4,500 — nearly four times the regular rate. Similarly, Sunil Tour and Travels is charging up to Rs 6,000 for Bhopal–Rewa. Dev High Speed Travels has listed fares up to Rs 4,500, while Anjuman Travels is charging up to Rs 5,000. On regular days, the same routes cost between Rs 900 and Rs 1,200. For Bhopal–Mumbai, Ratan Tour and Travels is quoting fares up to Rs 6,006, compared to the usual Rs 1,400–1,700 range. On the Bhopal–Lucknow route, Betwanti Travels has raised ticket prices to Rs 8,899, against the standard Rs 1,400–1,800 fare. Transport department has limited control The Transport Department has clarified that it does not directly regulate fares displayed on online booking apps. Ticket prices are set by individual bus operators, while apps simply reflect those rates. As demand rises during festivals, fares often increase sharply. Bhopal RTO Jitendra Sharma stated that passengers facing overcharging can lodge complaints directly with the department. Bus owners’ association responds Jai Kumar Jain, General Secretary of the Madhya Pradesh Bus Owners Association, said stage carriage buses are not involved in fare irregularities. According to him, vehicles operating under All India Tourist Permits — allegedly being used illegally as stage carriages — are responsible for charging inflated fares, and there is limited control over such vehicles. Chief Minister issues warning Notably, just a day earlier, Chief Minister Dr Mohan Yadav instructed Superintendents of Police and IGs via video conferencing to curb illegal fare collection during the festive rush. He directed officials to act strictly against overcharging and ensure special sensitivity during festival travel.
