stories.summary: Harsh Singh apologized after allegations of racial slurs and intimidation against three women from Arunachal Pradesh. The incident, stemming from a dispute over repair work, led to Singh's wife Ruby Jain's arrest. Singh expressed shame and requested a fair investigation, stating the confrontation occurred in the heat of the moment.

stories.title: Jharkhand air ambulance crash: Family borrowed Rs 8 lakh for ill-fated medical flight
After Israel’s nod, ‘lost tribe’ gets ready to leave India
stories.summary: Israel plans to bring 5,800 Bnei Menashe from India to Israel by 2030. This community believes it is descended from one of Israel's lost tribes. The Israeli government will fund their migration, including flights, Hebrew lessons, and housing. The Bnei Menashe will settle in northern Israel.

stories.title: Delhi govt brings widow, disability programme beneficiaries under Ayushman Bharat scheme
stories.summary: Delhi's government is extending Ayushman Bharat health scheme benefits to approximately 3.97 lakh widows and 1.31 lakh Divyang individuals, along with their families. This significant move aims to bolster health security for an additional 5.5 lakh families, ensuring no needy citizen is denied medical treatment due to financial constraints.

stories.title: 'My heritage isn’t an insult': Indian-origin Texas candidate fires back at reporter over mockery
'No greater patriotism than this': Rahul Gandhi praises 'Mohammad Deepak' for standing against hate - watch
'Charlie was martyred for his beliefs': Donald Trump pays tribute to the Kirks in State of the Union speech
What is Dalilah's Law? Trump seeks license ban for illegal immigrants after Indian-origin driver case
stories.summary: US President Trump has proposed "Dalilah's Law," aiming to prevent states from granting driver's licenses to undocumented immigrants. The legislation is named after Dalilah Coleman, a young girl severely injured in a crash allegedly caused by an undocumented truck driver. Trump also advocated for stricter criminal justice reforms, emphasizing keeping repeat offenders incarcerated.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia bans poultry imports from 40 countries including India amid health concerns
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has implemented extensive import bans on poultry and table eggs from 40 countries due to ongoing disease concerns, primarily avian influenza. An additional 16 nations face regional import restrictions. Exemptions are available for heat-treated products meeting strict health and certification requirements.

stories.title: Delhi to be renamed Indraprastha? BJP MP writes to Amit Shah after Kerala's name change
stories.summary: A BJP MP has proposed renaming Delhi to Indraprastha. He believes this name connects the capital to its ancient past. The MP cited historical evidence linking Delhi to the Mahabharata. He also suggested renaming key transport hubs. This move aims to reconnect with India's roots and foster cultural revival. The proposal follows the recent approval to rename Kerala as Keralam.

stories.title: 'Will not allow anybody to defame SC': CJI pulls up NCERT over text on judicial corruption
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has taken serious note of a Class 8 NCERT textbook referencing corruption in the judiciary. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant expressed strong disapproval, calling it a potential conspiracy to defame the institution. The textbook's inclusion of this sensitive topic, while omitting similar issues in other sectors, has raised concerns among legal figures and judges.

stories.title: 'Bad policy, but nice guy': Donald Trump on NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani
stories.summary: During his State of the Union address, US President Trump unexpectedly mentioned New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, calling him a "nice guy" despite ideological differences. Trump used Mamdani as an example to advocate for stricter voter ID laws, contrasting the requirements for a snow-shoveling job with those for voting.

stories.title: 'Welcome, Modi': Jerusalem Post front page features PM as he embarks on 2-day Israel visit
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi graces the front page of The Jerusalem Post ahead of his historic visit to Israel. The newspaper highlights the burgeoning India-Israel partnership and Modi's upcoming address to the Knesset, marking a significant milestone. Discussions will focus on deepening bilateral ties across various sectors, including technology, defense, and economy.

stories.title: 'Hope he mentions the genocide': Priyanka Gandhi urges PM Modi to highlight Gaza plight during Israel visit
stories.summary: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to address the Gaza crisis during his Israel visit and speak for justice for civilians. This call comes as PM Modi embarks on a state visit to Israel. The Congress party has also criticized the government's stance on the conflict, accusing it of abandoning the Palestinian cause.

stories.title: 'Pakistan PM would have died... ': Donald Trump misspeaks in State of the Union address - what he meant
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump claimed during his State of the Union address that his intervention prevented a nuclear war between India and Pakistan, stating the Pakistan Prime Minister would have died without his involvement. He cited praise from the Pakistani PM for saving "35 million" lives. However, India has rejected any third-party mediation in de-escalating tensions during Operation Sindoor.

stories.title: 'Will consolidate ties': PM Modi leaves for Israel — what’s on agenda
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Israel aims to further consolidate the strong bond and strategic partnership between the two nations. Discussions with Israeli counterpart Benjamin Netanyahu will focus on strengthening cooperation across various domains, including defense, trade, technology, and economic ties, while also addressing regional developments.

stories.title: 'Always been Keralam': UAE Malayalis react to Kerala's proposed name change
'Black people aren't apes!' US lawmaker Al Green escorted out for protest during Donald Trump's speech
stories.summary: During President Trump's State of the Union, Democratic Rep. Al Green was removed from the House chamber for holding a sign stating 'Black people aren’t apes!' This protest referenced a racist video of the Obamas on Trump's social media. Green aimed for Trump to see the message, asserting Black people are not apes.

stories.title: Mistaken identity? 57-year-old Gurudwara cook who was kidnapped and killed was not intended target
stories.summary: A Sikh temple volunteer, Avtaar Singh, was abducted and found dead in California, authorities confirmed. Officials stated Singh was not the intended target of the kidnapping, which occurred after another individual for a specific, undisclosed reason. His body was discovered nearly 100 miles from the temple where he was last seen.

stories.title: Parliamentary panel passes resolution against AI summit protest, opposition MPs dissent
stories.summary: A parliamentary committee condemned the Youth Congress's AI summit protest, passing a resolution with a majority vote despite opposition from several parties. While praising the summit's success and significant investment pledges, the dissenters argued the committee was engaging in political maneuvering over the incident. The resolution highlighted the summit's global impact and future AI development commitments.

stories.title: Abandoned and decaying: What’s left inside Jeffrey Epstein’s ‘Lolita Express’ after years grounded?
stories.summary: For nearly a decade, Jeffrey Epstein’s former Boeing 727 has sat abandoned in Georgia, engines stripped and interior decaying. Once used to ferry powerful figures and, prosecutors say, trafficking victims between his properties, the jet remains a haunting relic of his crimes. Despite ownership changes and scrapping plans, it endures as a physical symbol of scandal and unanswered questions.

stories.title: Ahmedabad Metro, Srinagar airport extension, 3 rail projects get nod
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet greenlit significant infrastructure upgrades, including three multi-tracking railway projects totaling Rs 9,072 crore to boost train capacity. Additionally, a new integrated airport terminal for Srinagar, costing Rs 1,677 crore, and a Rs 1,067 crore extension for the Ahmedabad Metro were approved. These projects aim to enhance connectivity and cater to growing passenger demand.

stories.title: 2 planes had taken off from Ranchi minutes before crash
stories.summary: Two commercial flights, an Air India and an IndiGo, departed Ranchi safely Monday night amidst challenging weather. The ill-fated air ambulance, a Beechcraft C90, crashed shortly after takeoff, having requested a weather deviation. This tragedy occurred just minutes after larger airliners navigated the same turbulent conditions successfully.

stories.summary: Move aimed at enforcing zero-tolerance policy: DGCA

stories.title: Societies can’t function without reliable access to space, SatCom is ‘dual use oxygen’: Viasat prez
stories.summary: Satellite communications are vital for modern society, enabling everything from weather forecasts to national security, Viasat's President Ben Palmer stated at DefSat 2026. He emphasized the need for resilient global SatCom and assured connectivity across various orbits and frequencies. Palmer also highlighted India's strategic approach to space sovereignty as impressive and pragmatic.

stories.title: India to launch HPV vax drive for 14-year-old girls this month
Alysa Liu reveals emotional post-Olympic life plan after gold, hints at unexpected future beyond competitive figure skating
stories.summary: Alysa Liu captured Olympic gold at the 2026 Milano Cortina Games with a powerful free skate, becoming the first American woman in years to reach that milestone. Her victory, along with team gold, marked a major moment for U.S. figure skating. Now, Liu is looking beyond medals, sharing her interest in fashion, storytelling, and creative expression. Her Olympic moment has become both an athletic triumph and the start of a broader personal journey.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez combined net worth in 2026: Football player and model wife among richest couples with $1.4 billion fortune
stories.summary: Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo and his partner Georgina Rodriguez are among the world's richest athletes. By 2026, Ronaldo's wealth is projected to be around $1.4 billion from his Al Nassr contract, Nike deal, and businesses. Georgina's net worth is estimated at $10 million from modeling and her Netflix series. Together, their combined wealth is substantial.

stories.summary: Antonela Roccuzzo, Lionel Messi’s wife, has built an estimated $20 million net worth through modeling, brand partnerships, and social media influence. Born in Rosario, she grew from a private figure into a global lifestyle icon. With major fashion collaborations, philanthropic work, and over 40 million followers, she balances family life with business success and international recognition.

stories.title: No question of Aadhaar being used to claim citizenship: Supreme Court
Jharkhand, Odisha judicial officers to be drafted to speed up Bengal SIR
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has allowed the Calcutta High Court Chief Justice to enlist judicial officers from Jharkhand and Odisha to expedite the verification of 50 lakh voters in West Bengal facing 'logical discrepancy' or 'unmapped' status. The apex court clarified Aadhaar is solely for identification, not citizenship claims, and supplementary voter lists will be published post-February 28.

stories.title: Fact check: Did Megyn Kelly help Candace Owens produce “Bride of Charlie” trailer about Erika Kirk and Charlie Kirk?
stories.summary: After backlash followed the trailer release, Megyn Kelly publicly responded to claims about her involvement. She focused on the exact language used by Candace Owens and denied that a direct murder accusation was made against Erika Kirk. Kelly’s comments, shared on her SiriusXM program, have added fresh attention to the ongoing public debate.

stories.summary: The Supreme Court has permitted Kerala's 'Nava Keralam Citizen Response Programme' to proceed, overturning a High Court decision. The apex court acknowledged that determining the allocation of funds for welfare schemes falls outside judicial purview. The Kerala government must later provide an account of how the Rs 20 crore was utilized.

stories.title: Proud of 'babbar shers' of Youth Congress: Rahul on AI meet stir
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi praised Indian Youth Congress members arrested for protesting the AI Summit, calling them "babbar shers" who exposed a "compromised PM." The BJP criticized Gandhi, labeling him a "running joke" and accusing him of anarchic conduct and ignorance regarding the US trade agreement.

stories.title: Is the 2026 FIFA World Cup schedule at risk? FIFA addresses relocation fears amid rising security concerns
stories.summary: Security concerns in parts of Mexico have raised questions about whether 2026 FIFA World Cup matches could be relocated. FIFA says it is closely monitoring the situation with authorities and prioritizes safety. Officials stress that moving games would be a last resort, and the tournament across the United States, Canada, and Mexico remains scheduled as planned.

Cabinet approval to rename Kerala reflects will of people of state: PM Modi
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved renaming Kerala as Keralam, fulfilling a long-standing popular demand. This decision aligns with the state assembly's resolutions and reflects the will of the people. The process will involve the President referring the matter to the state assembly for its views before parliamentary action.

stories.title: Jake Paul’s fiance Jutta Leerdam earns royal honour at Huis ten Bosch Palace after record breaking Olympic win
stories.summary: Jutta Leerdam won gold in the 1,000m and silver in the 500m at the Milano Cortina Winter Olympics. After her success, she was named a Knight of the Order of Orange-Nassau by the Dutch royal family. The ceremony took place at Huis ten Bosch Palace. Jake Paul celebrated proudly as fans praised her achievements online.

stories.title: Rodeo champion Kelsie Domer’s 3 year old daughter Oaklynn dies after tragic horse accident during medical episode
stories.summary: Rodeo champion Kelsie Domer’s 3 year old daughter Oaklynn died on February 19 after a horse suffered a medical episode and fell on them. Kelsie survived but Oaklynn did not. The news was shared through an obituary and reported by Rodeo Life. The rodeo community honored Oaklynn by wearing pink and sharing heartfelt tributes.

Trade, defence & security on agenda as PM Modi heads to Israel; visit amid US threat of attack on Iran
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's two-day visit to Israel, commencing Wednesday, aims to strengthen the strategic partnership and address shared challenges. The agenda includes meetings with Israeli counterpart Benjamin Netanyahu, an address to the Knesset, and discussions on technology, defense, and trade. An upgraded security pact and a potential free trade agreement are key outcomes anticipated from this significant diplomatic engagement.

Graft in judiciary, cases backlog in NCERT book
stories.summary: Class 8 students will now learn about judicial challenges like corruption, massive case backlogs, and judge shortages. The new NCERT textbook highlights how these issues hinder justice, especially for the poor. It details pending cases across courts and mentions efforts to boost transparency and accountability, including a code of conduct for judges and a grievance system.

stories.summary: Russia's intelligence agency alleges Britain and France are secretly planning to supply nuclear weapons to Ukraine, a claim vehemently denied by Kyiv and France as "an outright lie" and "absurd." Moscow stated this information is crucial for ongoing peace talks, while Ukraine urged the international community to reject Russia's "dirty information bombs."

stories.title: BoJo says send non-combat European troops to Ukraine now
stories.summary: Former UK PM Boris Johnson urged Europe to deploy non-combat troops to Ukraine immediately, criticizing the continent's insufficient pressure on Russia. He argued that such a move would demonstrate commitment and push Putin towards negotiations. Johnson also highlighted Europe's continued energy imports from Russia, calling for increased urgency to secure Ukraine's victory at a lower cost.

stories.summary: Major League Baseball introduced an automated ball-and-strike (ABS) challenge system to improve fairness and consistency in officiating. This hybrid approach allows players to challenge calls, aiming to reduce prolonged arguments and keep the game moving. Influenced by minor league tests and a recent Spring Training dispute, the system preserves umpire judgment while leveraging technology for accuracy.

stories.title: LA Knight and Michelle Yavulla combined net worth in 2026: WWE salary, brand value, and financial success story
stories.summary: WWE's LA Knight, real name Shaun Ricker, is a rising star with impressive mic skills and charisma. His career success, boosted by a new contract and merchandise sales, is reflected in his growing net worth. Knight's financial success, alongside his wife Michelle Yavulla, is projected to reach $4-10 million by early 2026, showcasing their strong presence in sports entertainment.

stories.title: Police attach Pakistan-based terror handler’s Kathua property
stories.summary: Kathua Police have attached approximately 7.5 marlas of land belonging to Pakistan-based terror handler Swar Din in Lohai Malhar tehsil. The action was ordered by the Jammu additional sessions court after Din, declared a proclaimed offender, evaded arrest. This move aims to dismantle terror financing and logistical support.

stories.title: Omar Abdullah urges Kashmiri students to leave Iran soon
CaseOh caught off guard as massive fan-made plush takes over his stream
stories.summary: Streamer CaseOh went viral after unwrapping a seven-foot crocheted plush made in his likeness by Clovis creator Christian, known as “The Crochet Ginger.” The handmade doll was revealed during a livestream and quickly gained attention online. With over 1.1 million TikTok followers, the crochet artist’s detailed creation impressed fans and sparked widespread social media reactions.

stories.title: Paid $200 for one night, stayed 5 years rent-free: The New York hotel case that ended in a guilty plea
The Bride Of Charlie: Candace Owens sparks rift with Erika Kirk exposé; only Matt Walsh speaks out
stories.summary: Candace Owens has stirred major controversy after releasing the trailer for her YouTube investigative series The Bride of Charlie, centered on Erika Kirk. The preview quickly went viral, prompting backlash, intense online debate, and questions directed at Charlie Kirk’s allies. While supporters call it accountability journalism, critics warn it risks harassment and speculation, as silence from prominent conservative voices fuels growing tension.

stories.title: The Butterfly Effect: How Hamas attack on Oct 7 destroyed Iran's Axis of Resistance
stories.summary: That day, a terrorist organisation’s desire to imbibe a little culture by paragliding into a music festival ended up rewriting the world order. The story that followed could have been directed by Quentin Tarantino: gory, non-linear, with all threads interconnected and a few perverts thrown in. Israel’s furious response, with help from Uncle Sam, led to the dismantling of Iran’s Axis of Resistance, tangentially hastened Trump’s return to the White House, and reminded Russia, China, and even Europe who is Daddy.
